name: 2 Player Raid Tycoon
creator: STRAY FRAME
redeem: Launch 2 Player Raid Tycoon on Roblox, finish the tutorial and claim your side of a factory.
Tap the Store button on the left side of the screen.
Scroll to the bottom of the Store to the Enter a code to unlock rewards section.
Type or paste the code into the Enter Code box and press Redeem.
notes:
2 Player Raid Tycoon is a co-op factory tycoon from the STRAY FRAME group, released on Roblox in September 2026. You and a partner claim the two sides of a factory, run droppers, conveyors and upgraders to earn cash, and build the factory up floor by floor. You can also raid rival factories by knocking out their power, cracking the vault and carrying the cash home, while defending your own with walls, laser doors, turrets and guards.

Codes usually give cash, gems, guard tickets, airstrikes and short 2x cash boosts, which help most while you are building the first few floors. The game page promises new codes when the game reaches like milestones, and the developers also post them in their Discord.

faq.q: Do you need anything before redeeming 2 Player Raid Tycoon codes?
faq.a: Yes. Finish the short tutorial and claim your side of the factory first. The Store, where the code box lives, only opens after that.

faq.q: When is the next 2 Player Raid Tycoon code coming out?
faq.a: The game description promises a new code when the game reaches 7,500 likes. The developers also post new codes in their Discord.

faq.q: What are Guard Tickets from codes used for in 2 Player Raid Tycoon?
faq.a: Guard Tickets are used to recruit guards for your factory, with rolls for Rare, Epic and Legendary defenders. LAUNCH and TY5500 each give one.

faq.q: What does the Airstrike reward from codes do?
faq.a: An Airstrike calls a strike on enemy players, including whoever raided you. TY5500 gives one, along with cash, gems, a Guard Ticket and a 5-minute 2x cash boost.

tips: Agree on roles with your partner early. One of you can keep buying droppers and upgraders while the other puts up walls and turrets, so the factory grows and stays protected at the same time.

Unlock better guns before you start raiding. There are 9 weapons, from the pistol up to the flamethrower and rocket launcher, and a stronger gun makes it much easier to fight past a rival's defenders.
A raid has three steps: shoot out the rival's power, crack their vault, then run the cash back to your own factory. Plan your route home before you go in.
Keep an eye on the events that start every few minutes. Double Cash is a good time to stay home and collect, while Air Drops, King of the Hill and Oddball give you a reason to head out.
useRewards: LAUNCH gives 1,000 Cash and a Guard Ticket. Spend the cash on droppers and upgraders right away, because more income early speeds up every floor after it. Roll the Guard Ticket once your vault has some walls around it, so the new defender has something to protect. If a later code includes a 2x Cash boost or an Airstrike, start the boost while your factory is running and keep the Airstrike for a team that just raided you.
